QUOTE: | Engine → caller (`char*` return or out-param) | Caller owns it; free with `entropic_free()` | Doc comment only | and | Engine → caller (`const char*`) | Owned by the handle, valid until the next call on that handle. Do not free. | Doc comment only |
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer's memory table states both halves: an owned `char*` is freed with `entropic_free`, and a `const char*` stays handle-owned and is valid until the next call on that handle.
